structured.answer: The page puts a star and the word "הזול" (the cheapest) on a פסגות account with the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", and it says I'd end up with 86,492 ₪ "בכסף של היום" (in today's money) after 10 years (10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month). I wouldn't act on it myself, though. I don't know פסגות as a bank. My own bank, לאומי, came second at 83,396 ₪. I'd ask you or the bank before putting money in.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the title and the buttons
stuck.why: It opens with 'להשקיע במדד' (invest in an index) and English letters, S&P 500 and MSCI. To me מדד is the price index on the news. Without the task I would have closed the page right there.

The amounts were already filled in: 10,000, 500, 10 years, 7%. I didn't know whether that 7% is a promise or a guess, or whether I should change the numbers. There are sliders under the boxes and I didn't touch them.

There are dozens of funds with coloured labels, like 'צוברת' (accumulating), 'עסקת החלף' (swap), 'חשיפה לדולר' (exposure to the dollar) and 'נאמן' (trustee). I didn't know which one to look at. I just went with the one that had a circle already marked next to it.
The funds are on the left and the accounts (banks) are on the right. It took me a while to understand that I have to choose both a fund and a place to hold it.
Rows of numbers with a minus sign, like −447, −1,268 and −4,492 ₪. I didn't understand whether that's a loss or just less money compared with the first one. It frightened me.
There's a chart with many lines, and below it '−21.8% ב־2022' (in 2022). That's exactly what I was afraid of, and I stopped there.

used: The star 'הזול' and 'הבחירה שלכם' (your choice): 86,492 ₪, 'נשאר לכם בעוד 10 שנים, אחרי דמי ניהול ומס, בכסף של היום' (what's left after management fees and tax, in today's money)
The fund name 'ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)' with 'דמי ניהול 0%' (0% management fee)
The list of accounts: פסגות 86,492, לאומי 83,396, הבינלאומי 82,371, מזרחי טפחות 77,695
skimmed: The coloured bars in the list of accounts
The paragraph 'למה חלק מהקרנות בלי מחיר בפסגות' (why some funds have no price at פסגות)
The table of what changes how much you're left with (years, monthly deposit)

The fold-out arrows next to 'לא בחישוב' (not in the calculation)
unsure_meaning: מדד (I know it as the price index, not as something you invest in)
צוברת, מחלקת דיבידנד (accumulating, pays a dividend)
Minus numbers like −43 ₪ and −4,492 ₪: a loss, or the difference from the cheapest?
+0.37% next to 'מול המדד' (compared with the index)
'בכסף של היום' (in today's money): is the money really worth more than that?
The colours of the bars: orange, yellow and red that look alike
not_found: Anything about deposits or safe savings
A clear sentence saying whether you can lose the money

findings.what: The page opens with English letters and investment words. Nothing on the first screen says whether this is safe, and someone like me would close the page.
Lots of minus numbers, and some in red, in the fund list and the account list. It isn't explained whether they're a loss or a difference.
A long list of funds with many coloured labels that mean nothing to me. It's crowded and it made me anxious.
The 'הזול' (cheapest) recommendation is a company I don't know, not my bank. Nothing says why I should trust it.
The return is filled in ahead of time (7%). It isn't clear that this is a guess.
Small, pale-grey text on black, like 'לא בחישוב' and the explanations under each bank. It's hard to read even with glasses.
'−21.8% ב־2022' in large letters with no reassuring explanation
A chart with many lines in similar colours that I can't read
